audit_items.proof_trace: cancel() reads capitalToReturn = totalCapitalWithdrawn (= totalCapitalRaised set by withdrawRaisedCapital) and pulls that exact amount back from the project via safeTransferFrom. At the time withdrawRaisedCapital succeeds, the contract held totalCapitalInvested >= totalCapitalRaised (otherwise the safeTransfer would have reverted), so after cancel the contract balance = totalCapitalInvested >= totalCapitalRaised = raisedCapital + fees. If safeTransferFrom in cancel() reverts, the entire transaction reverts atomically, leaving isCanceled false.
